text.text_excerpt: My wife and I booked a weekend for a getaway to New Orleans looking for something different from the usual hotel experience. This property is fabulous and the staff are excellent. Intuitive and over the top service at every turn. We took a tour of the entire property which is offered daily that told us about the history of the church, school and neighborhood. The coffee shop and Elysian bar were perfect for a night cap or dinner. Food was amazing and the bar was beautiful and extremely well stocked. We tried different specialty drinks every night. Perfect location on quiet burgundy street with an easy walk to live music on Frenchmen street and the French quarter. 3 blocks to the street ca...

Hotel Peter & Paul is incredibly beautiful. The renovated church turned hotel has every modern comfort you'd like - and I was pleasantly surprised to find the rooms are well insulated from the outside noise. We requested the second floor, which has higher ceilings I believe. Jamal was the best - he and the crew had all the tips regarding the location. This was my third time in New Orleans but usually I stay closer to Canal - this was a great way to break the habit, although I did end up Uber-ing to and from the hotel mostly (rain). My wife and I were shocked at this spectacular renovation! The miracle of the details put into this hotel should have the city abuzz! I'm dead serious when I say that this is the perfect location for the more sophisticated visitor... those more interested in getting to really know this city and it's complexities could find no better starting point. From the amazing room literature (I highly recommend out-of-towners read the insiders tips provided in your room!) to the imported European furniture and design elements that give the entire space a French Orleans flair... the stay was a delight!
